async function run(items, op, width, options, count) {
	// ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	await lib.mapLimit<string>(items, 1, op);
	// ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	await mapLimit<string, void>(items, 1, op);
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	await mapLimit<string>(items, op, { ...options, concurrency: 1 });
	await mapLimit<string>(items, op, { concurrency: 1, ...options });
	await mapLimit<string>(items, 4, op);
	await mapLimit<string>(items, width, op);
	await mapLimit<string>(items, Math.min(4, count, items.length), op);
	const capped = Math.min(count, 1, items.length);
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	await mapLimit<string>(items, capped, op);
}
